chapter.name: Grafana & Friends Mumbai
chapter.tagline: The Official Observability & Open-Source Community in Mumbai
chapter.description: A vibrant community of developers, SREs, DevOps engineers, and cloud-native enthusiasts in Mumbai, powered by Grafana Labs. We meet to explore metrics, logs, traces, continuous profiling, and modern cloud-native observability practices.

mascot.name: Grot
mascot.title: Official Grafana & Community Mascot
mascot.bio: Grot is Grafana's beloved explorer mascot. With a glowing visor and curiosity for metrics, logs, traces, and profiles, Grot guides observability adventurers through complex distributed architectures.
mascot.quote: "May your queries be fast, your dashboards clear, and your latency low!"

tips.tip: Use rate() on counters with a time window at least 4x your scrape interval to avoid noisy spikes caused by missed scrapes.
Filter high-volume logs with stream selectors first (e.g. {env='prod', app='gateway'}) before running heavy regex or line extraction.
Pinpoint latency bottlenecks by querying traces with { duration > 500ms && status = error } for immediate root cause discovery.
Continuous profiling with Pyroscope reveals CPU flame graphs across production without degrading system throughput.
Anchor your primary SRE dashboards on the 4 Golden Signals: Latency, Traffic, Errors, and Saturation.

ecosystem.name: Grafana
ecosystem.description: The open-source analytics & interactive visualization platform for metrics, logs, and traces.

ecosystem.name: Prometheus
ecosystem.description: Systems monitoring and alerting toolkit with a dimensional data model and powerful PromQL.

ecosystem.name: OpenTelemetry
ecosystem.description: Vendor-neutral open standard and SDKs for generating, collecting, and exporting telemetry data.

ecosystem.name: Grafana Loki
ecosystem.description: Horizontally-scalable, highly-available, multi-tenant log aggregation system inspired by Prometheus.

ecosystem.name: Grafana Tempo
ecosystem.description: Massively scalable distributed tracing backend requiring only object storage to operate.

ecosystem.name: Grafana Mimir
ecosystem.description: Horizontally scalable, highly available multi-tenant long-term storage for Prometheus.

ecosystem.name: Grafana Pyroscope
ecosystem.description: Open-source continuous profiling platform to optimize CPU, memory, and runtime efficiency.

ecosystem.name: Kubernetes
ecosystem.description: Production-grade container orchestration system for automating deployment and scaling.

ecosystem.name: Cilium & eBPF
ecosystem.description: eBPF-powered networking, observability, and security for cloud native infrastructure.

ecosystem.name: Jaeger
ecosystem.description: Open-source, end-to-end distributed tracing for complex cloud-native architectures.

faqs.question: What is Grafana & Friends Mumbai and how can I join?
faqs.answer: Grafana & Friends Mumbai is the official local community chapter for developers, SREs, DevOps engineers, and students passionate about observability. You can join for free on Meetup.com to get notified about all upcoming in-person and virtual meetups.

faqs.question: Is attending the meetups free?
faqs.answer: Yes! All Grafana & Friends Mumbai community meetups, workshops, and events are 100% free of charge and open to everyone, powered by Grafana Labs and our community partners.

faqs.question: How can I become a speaker or present a talk?
faqs.answer: We welcome community talks of all experience levels! Whether you want to share a 10-minute lightning demo or a 30-minute deep-dive talk on metrics, logs, traces, or incident response, submit your proposal through our open Call for Speakers (CFP) form.

faqs.question: What is the format and typical agenda of a meetup?
faqs.answer: Our meetups typically feature 2-3 technical talks, hands-on demonstrations, community Q&A, interactive quizzes with swag giveaways, and dedicated networking over complimentary food and beverages.

faqs.question: Can my company sponsor or host a future meetup?
faqs.answer: Yes! We are always looking for venue partners, community sponsors, and food/swag collaborators in Mumbai. Please reach out to our organizing team at grafanamumbai@gmail.com.

faqs.question: What Code of Conduct applies to community events?
faqs.answer: We adhere strictly to the Grafana Events Code of Conduct and Contributor Covenant to ensure a safe, inclusive, welcoming, and harassment-free environment for all participants.
